regulation.moratorium_cite: Para 13 (p.8): no policy/claim contestable on non-disclosure/misrepresentation, except established fraud, after 60 months of continuous coverage

regulation.committee_cite: Para 17(a) (p.9): no claim repudiated without approval of PMC / Claims Review Committee
